findings.title: Code-block headings can satisfy required sections
findings.description: The fence toggle recognizes only unindented triple-backtick prefixes and does not track fence length. Probes using tilde fences, indented fences, and four-backtick fences containing triple backticks all incorrectly returned `## Value` as a document heading. Consequently, code examples can satisfy missing sections. Track fence character and length, support valid indentation, and add regression tests.

findings.title: Unregistered worktrees silently use the primary checkout’s template
findings.description: `resolveProjectWorktree` discovers an unregistered Git worktree’s parent project but returns no `worktreeId`. `resolveOperationPath` then selects `project.projectPath`, so this command checks against the primary checkout’s template rather than the invoking checkout’s guide. Different guide versions can produce incorrect results. Resolve the actual checkout or explicitly reject unregistered worktrees; add coverage beyond the registered-worktree case.
